headline: Chemung Speedrome ushers in next era with new promoters
lede: Andy Malnoske on the handover: the Hodge family stepping back after their lease, George Nichols and Dan Mathews taking over the 3/8-mile oval, and a Friday-night season running May 1 through October 2.

headline: The wait is over — Chemung Speedrome to re-open for 2026 season
lede: Michael Jaworecki Sr. lays out the reopening: the lease from owner John White, the Friday 7:00 PM green flags, the four weekly divisions, and gate prices held at local rates.

headline: Chemung Speedrome ushers in next era with new promoters
lede: The WETM report on the track's return picked up for national syndication — same story on the relaunch, the new promoters, and the 2026 Friday-night schedule.
